text: APPROVE. The extracted helpers (`ClassifyNextFile`, `NextExportName`, `NextEndpointName`, `JudgeNextExport`) preserve the original logic, including the `k + 1 < t.Count` guards, the `continue` conditions and the endpoint/url/writes computation. `Next` itself drops to roughly 10 cognitive complexity, and I see no new warning sources in the patch, though I did not build it.
